§5_patient_assignment_binding_http.method: Real HTTP + real DB — full session cookie flow through Express app
flow_summary: 1. loginAs(clinician) → GET /csrf-token → POST /login → receive session cookie
2. Insert role assignment A (bht, facilityWide=false) into sos_role_assignments
3. Insert role assignment B (bht, revoked) into sos_role_assignments
4. Insert patient access row with FK=B (bound to revoked assignment B)
5. Build identity presenting grant A (not B)
6. Call authorize({...identity, roleAssignmentId=A, patientId}) — NOT a mock
7. Assert decision.allowed=false, reasonCode='patient-out-of-scope' — access row bound to B does NOT satisfy grant A
9. Assert patient NOT present in list — repository-level enforcement confirmed
13. Verify audit row for logout written to sos_auth_audit

§9_pg_rate_limit_store.note: Cross-process restart survival is architecturally guaranteed by the shared sos_rate_limit_windows table. The test suite exercises the UPSERT path directly, confirms counters increment atomically, and confirms resetKey() removes the row. Full multi-instance proof requires a second API process; documented here as a design guarantee with single-process UPSERT atomicity confirmed.
